name: Baltimore Initials 1832
designer: Baltimore Type Foundry; individual engravers generally unidentified (signed large cuts credited in the source inventory)
foundry: Baltimore Type Foundry; F. Lucas, Jr., agent
description: Historical decorated letters, figures and punctuation from Baltimore 1832 and matching period sources in Boston 1832, Howe 1830 and Bruce 1828, plus the leafy-descender Oak Leaf R. Includes 31 additional ornamented letters, figures and punctuation from Howe 1830. Includes 42 additional decorated letters, scroll figures and negative figures from Boston 1832.
observed: 80 complete ornamental sorts: 38 original Baltimore impressions, 27 matching period impressions, the complete-sheet Oak Leaf R, and 14 Bruce 1828 additions. Bruce supplies lottery figures 3, 4, 5 and comma, and the complete ornamented SODA water. setting. Its S, a and e have distinct hatched/internal decoration from the related Baltimore and Boston versions. Every item retains an exact crop and citation.
reconstructed: No inferred letters or new pictorial content. Thresholding, crop cleanup, cubic curve fitting and font-unit rounding interpret the observed impressions. Source identifiers, Private Use assignments, uniform scale and bearings are digital metadata and metrics. Original 38 items retain their existing monochrome and three-tone drawings, including reviewed 1.001 alignment. The 42 supplementary impressions are monochrome. No incomplete alphabet is offered as a text font.
